parole.significato: A monoclinic-prismatic light yellow mineral containing chlorine, lead, oxygen, and vanadium.
parole.testo: From Kombat + -ite, after the Kombat Mine in the north-central part of Namibia, from Herero [Term?] (given name).

parole.significato: A watercourse, which may be dry much of the year, in the Kalahari Desert.
